topics.title: Alphabet Recognition & Phonics
topics.content: Phonics sounds and letter recognition for all A-Z letters: A for Apple (/æ/), B for Ball (/b/), C for Cat (/k/), D for Dog (/d/), E for Elephant (/e/), F for Fish (/f/), G for Grapes (/ɡ/), H for House (/h/), I for Ice-cream (/aɪ/), J for Juice (/dʒ/), K for Kite (/k/), L for Lion (/l/), M for Monkey (/m/), N for Nest (/n/), O for Orange (/ɒ/), P for Parrot (/p/), Q for Queen (/kw/), R for Rabbit (/r/), S for Sun (/s/), T for Tiger (/t/), U for Umbrella (/ʌ/), V for Van (/v/), W for Watch (/w/), X for Xylophone (/ks/), Y for Yak (/j/), Z for Zebra (/z/). Uppercase (A-Z) and lowercase (a-z) letter matching.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Use fun sound effects (like 'A-a-apple!', 'B-b-ball!'), rhythm, and mouse gestures in English and Hinglish.

topics.title: Sight Words & 3-Letter Words (CVC)
topics.content: 3-letter CVC words (Consonant-Vowel-Consonant): short 'a' (cat, mat, rat, bat, sat); short 'e' (pen, ten, hen, red, bed); short 'i' (pin, tin, bin, sit, fit); short 'o' (top, dog, log, pot, mop); short 'u' (tub, sun, bun, run, cup). Basic sight words: the, is, in, at, on, it, my, see.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Break into sound blending: c - a - t = cat! Ask student to pronounce each letter sound slowly.

topics.title: Numbers 1 to 100 & Counting
topics.content: Counting objects 1 to 20, numeral identification 1-100, skip counting by 2s, 5s, and 10s, concept of zero (0 means none/empty), before/after/between numbers, big vs small, more vs less.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Ask student to count imaginary cheese slices or stars! Speak in Hinglish: 'Chalo count karte hain 1 se 100 tak!'

topics.title: Basic Shapes & Colors
topics.content: Basic Shapes: Circle (round like sun), Square (4 equal sides), Triangle (3 sides), Rectangle (2 long 2 short sides), Star (5 points), Heart, Oval (egg shape), Diamond (rhombus). Primary & Secondary Colors: Red, Blue, Yellow, Green, Orange, Purple, Pink, Black, White, Brown.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Ask: 'Can you find something round or Red around you right now?'

topics.title: Simple Addition & Subtraction (1-10)
topics.content: Visual addition using objects (2 apples + 3 apples = 5 apples). Visual subtraction (5 balloons - 2 pop = 3 left). Counting forward for addition and backward for subtraction.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Use fingers or objects in story-telling form.

topics.title: Animals, Birds & Insects
topics.content: Domestic/Farm Animals: Cow, Dog, Cat, Goat, Horse, Sheep. Wild Animals: Lion, Tiger, Elephant, Bear, Zebra, Giraffe. Birds: Peacock (National bird), Sparrow, Parrot, Eagle, Pigeon. Water Animals: Fish, Whale, Dolphin, Octopus. Insects: Butterfly, Ant, Honeybee. Animal sounds and homes (Dog lives in kennel, Lion in den).
topics.pedagogy_tip: Make cute animal sounds together with the student! 'What sound does a dog make? Woof woof!'

topics.title: Body Parts & 5 Senses
topics.content: Human Body Parts & 5 Senses: Eyes (see/sight), Ears (hear/sound), Nose (smell/smelling), Tongue (taste/tasting), Skin (touch/feeling). Head, Shoulders, Knees, Toes, Hands, Fingers, Legs, Feet, Teeth, Hair.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Sing the 'Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes' rhythm.

topics.title: Swar & Vyanjan (स्वर और व्यंजन)
topics.content: Hindi Swar (स्वर अ से अः): अ (अनार), आ (आम), इ (इमली), ई (ईख), उ (उल्लू), ऊ (ऊन), ऋ (ऋषि), ए (एड़ी), ऐ (ऐनक), ओ (ओखली), औ (औरत), अं (अंगूर), अः (अहा)। Hindi Vyanjan (व्यंजन क से ज्ञ): क (कबूतर), ख (खरगोश), ग (गमला), घ (घड़ी), ङ | च (चम्मच), छ (छाता), ज (जहाज), झ (झंडा), ञ | ट (टमाटर), ठ (ठठेरा), ड (डमरू), ढ (ढोलक), ण | त (तबला), थ (थर्मस), द (दरवाजा), ध (धनुष), न (नल) | प (पतंग), फ (फल), ब (बकरी), भ (भालू), म (मछली) | य (यज्ञ), र (रथ), ल (लट्टू), व (वक) | श (शलजम), ष (षट्कोण), स (सपेरा), ह (हाथी) | क्ष (क्षत्रिय), त्र (त्रिशूल), ज्ञ (ज्ञानी)। Complete pronunciation in Hindi & Hinglish.
topics.pedagogy_tip: Teach with affectionate Hindi phrases like 'शाबाश!', 'अरे वाह!', 'फिर से बोलो!' and interactive Hinglish repetition.
